brief:
The Guardian's Owen Jones argues that removing Benjamin Netanyahu from power would not necessarily end Israeli military operations in Gaza, cautioning against expectations that the opposition would pursue significantly different policies.

Jones points to statements from Israeli opposition figures characterizing Palestinians, including children, as enemies. He suggests the political consensus within Israel extends beyond Netanyahu to encompass broader support for military action in Gaza, regardless of which party holds power.
dek: It’s naive to think the Israeli opposition will act very differently. Look at what it has said about even the most vulnerable Palestinians “Every child, every baby in Gaza is the enemy.”
title: Israeli opposition unlikely to halt Gaza operations if Netanyahu falls, commentator warns
